title: 2 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 9
description: Ten questions on 2 Chronicles 9: the visit of the queen of Sheba, Solomon's gold and ivory throne, and the end of his reign.

questions.text: Why did the queen of Sheba come to Solomon in Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: When she heard of Solomon's fame, she came to test him with hard questions at Jerusalem.

answers.text: To ask for help against her enemies
To marry one of his sons
To buy cedar wood from Lebanon
To test him with hard questions

questions.text: What did the queen say about the report she had heard of Solomon's wisdom?
questions.explanation: She said half of the greatness of his wisdom had not been told to her; he exceeded the fame she had heard.

answers.text: It had been greatly exaggerated by the travelers
Half of the greatness of his wisdom had not been told her
She had never heard any report of him before
Only his riches had been reported, not his wisdom

questions.text: How much gold did the queen of Sheba give the king?
questions.explanation: She gave the king one hundred and twenty talents of gold, spices in great abundance and precious stones.

questions.text: What did the king make from the algum tree wood, besides terraces?
questions.explanation: He used algum wood for terraces for Yahweh's house and the king's house, and harps and stringed instruments for the singers.

answers.text: Chariots for his horsemen in the cities
Doors for the gates of the city walls
Harps and stringed instruments for the singers
Ships to sail on the sea to Ophir

questions.text: What was the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year?
questions.explanation: The weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred sixty-six talents.

questions.text: Where did the king put the three hundred shields of beaten gold?
questions.explanation: The king put the shields in the House of the Forest of Lebanon.

answers.text: In the House of the Forest of Lebanon
In the treasury of Yahweh's house
In the tower of the city of David
In the storage cities of Hamath

questions.text: Of what was Solomon's great throne made, and with what was it overlaid?
questions.explanation: The king made a great throne of ivory and overlaid it with pure gold.

questions.text: How many lions stood on the six steps of the throne?
questions.explanation: Twelve lions stood on the one side and on the other on the six steps.

questions.text: Besides gold, silver and ivory, what did the ships of Tarshish bring?
questions.explanation: Once every three years the ships of Tarshish brought gold, silver, ivory, apes and peacocks.

questions.text: How long did Solomon reign in Jerusalem over all Israel?
questions.explanation: Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.
